name: alegomes
description: Multi-agent marketplace for Claude Code: shared mindset skills (common); topologies (multi-team — 9-agent generic; solo-pair — 2-agent lightweight; hex-backend — 13-agent hexagonal-architecture; discovery — 6-agent continuous product discovery; book — 10-agent book-writing; git-history — 3-agent Git-history analysis); plus a Jira lifecycle layer (jira-flow). Originally adapted from indydev Dan's lead-agents pattern.

plugins.name: common
plugins.description: Shared mindset skills required by the topology plugins (mental-model, active-listener, zero-micromanagement, conversational-response, till-done).

plugins.name: multi-team
plugins.description: Multi-team agent topology — orchestrator + 3 leads + 6 workers, with path-lock hook. Requires common@alegomes.

plugins.name: solo-pair
plugins.description: Lightweight 2-agent topology — one dev, one reviewer, no leads. For small tweaks where multi-team orchestration overhead isn't worth it. Requires common@alegomes.

plugins.name: hex-backend
plugins.description: Hexagonal-architecture backend topology — 13 agents across 3 teams (planning, engineering, validation) with a per-Task quality loop (qa → refactor-advisor → code-reviewer). Path-lock keyed to the standard domain/application/api-rest/infrastructure/bootstrap Maven layout. Requires common@alegomes. Pair with jira-flow@alegomes for Jira lifecycle.

plugins.name: discovery
plugins.description: Continuous product-discovery topology — 6 agents (discovery-lead + opportunity-framer + user-researcher + assumption-tester + evidence-auditor + epic-briefer) for translating raw signals into validated opportunities. Path-lock keyed to docs/discovery/**. Pair with jira-flow@alegomes for board lifecycle, and with hex-backend or multi-team for delivery handoff. Requires common@alegomes.

plugins.name: jira-flow
plugins.description: Adds atlassian-expert worker plus Jira-aware slash commands (capture, plan-track-build-validate, execute, drain, advance) on top of any topology that ships planning-lead/engineering-lead/validation-lead OR declares a custom lifecycle in .claude/jira-flow.lifecycle.yaml (used by /advance). Tested with hex-backend, multi-team, and discovery. Won't work with solo-pair for the lead-based commands. Requires common@alegomes.

plugins.name: book
plugins.description: Book-writing topology — 2 leads + 10 workers for authoring technical books. /book:inception grills the author for audience + produces chapter map. /book:write-chapter runs the per-chapter loop (outline→research→draft→code→exercises→review). /book:finalize runs continuity review across all chapters then compiles to LaTeX. Standalone. Requires common@alegomes.

plugins.name: git-history
plugins.description: Git-history analysis topology — orchestrator + git-historian lead + 2 workers (history-collector, history-narrator). Two jobs: tell a project's story from its branch/commit history, and analyze effort allocation across one or more repos on a single timeline. A deterministic collector (scripts/collect.py) extracts effort proxies + narrative signals into datapack.json; scripts/render.py draws matplotlib charts; the narrator writes prose + a structured report, separating evidence from inference. /git-history:analyze runs the flow. Standalone. Requires common@alegomes.
